## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why the change is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or enhancement
- [ ] Documentation or repository hygiene
- [ ] Refactor (no intentional behaviour change)
- [ ] Tests only
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## User impact

Describe what changes for someone using Scriptorium. If there is no visible
change, say why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have tested the change on Windows 11 where applicable
- [ ] I have not staged `scriptorium_config.json`, secrets, `dist/`, `build/`, `__pycache__/`, or `*.exe`
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behaviour, setup, or maintenance workflow has changed
- [ ] British English spelling is used in user-facing text
- [ ] Copyright / proprietary notices are unchanged
- [ ] New dependencies or workflow permissions are justified

## Test plan

List the checks run locally or in CI, plus any manual Windows verification.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out risk areas, follow-ups, or intentional omissions.
